_help: Partner servers shown in the launcher (Home and the Partners page). Add one, push to GitHub (publish.bat), and every launcher shows it within a few minutes. Images go in the partners/ folder next to this file: a square logo (256x256 or bigger) and a wide banner (about 1200x400). Set "hidden": true to take a partner off without deleting it.
